verdict.rationale: Airwallex's first-party webhook docs say it sends real-time push notifications when account events occur, delivered as an HTTP POST with a JSON payload to your URL. That is a programmatic outbound callback mechanism. The pack only gives the overview, though, so how subscriptions are set up and managed is not detailed. Missing for 10: documentation of the event-type catalog and subscription management (UI/API registration), signature verification and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks enable Airwallex to send instant, real-time push notifications to your application when events occur in your Airwallex account.
Airwallex sends an HTTP POST request to your URL with a JSON payload
